units.source_text: 这一天正是八月十五，月光皎洁，夜色清幽。

en.t: This day was precisely the fifteenth day of the eighth month, with bright, clear moonlight and a quiet, secluded night.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝历历回思往事，感慨无穷，不禁悄然而悲。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku vividly recalled the events of the past, was overcome with endless emotion, and could not help falling into silent sorrow.

units.source_text: 对公子言道：“迩来久无管弦之兴。

en.t: He said to the young lord, "Of late, it has been long since we enjoyed the pleasures of pipes and strings.

units.source_text: 昔日常闻皇弟雅奏，多年未得再赏了！”

en.t: In former days I often heard my imperial brother's elegant playing, but for many years I have not had the chance to enjoy it again!"
Prince Genji, deeply moved, composed a poem and said:
